videos.script: Right now, in the course's lab, a machine on the internet can open a connection to the shop's database. {{flat}} Nobody decided that. It is what a network does when nobody has decided anything. Every machine reaches every other. {{every}} This lesson draws the lines. First the perimeter, between the company and the internet. {{perimeter}} Then the DMZ, a zone for the one server the internet is meant to reach. Then the zones inside. {{zones}} You will write three firewall rules and test them from three places. Afterwards, the internet reaches the shop and nothing else. The shop reaches its database and nothing else. {{after}} And you will see why the inside of a network matters as much as its edge. {{inside}}
